feed.title: Finance Committee — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: When an agenda is posted or changed, and when a meeting’s recording, transcript and our minutes are all in.

entry.title: Finance Committee: the meeting of 24 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: FinCom will likely fund an outside review of the school department's FY26 budget overruns from its reserve. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=euQG57Zrac0), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: Finance Committee: agenda posted for the meeting of 24 September 2026
entry.summary: The town posted the agenda for the Finance Committee meeting of 24 September 2026. The agenda itself: https://www.lunenburgma.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_09242026-8027

entry.title: Finance Committee: the meeting of 27 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Finance Committee recommended the new-state-aid school spending plan, but deferred the funding source for the rest of the warrant to town meeting itself. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LGdwK249dSA), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: Finance Committee: the meeting of 13 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
